findings.sourceExample: In a crisis, try to keep your head.
findings.priorTargetPattern: \bkeep(?:s|ing)? a cool head\b|\bkept a cool head\b
findings.issue: The proposed lesson and canonical 491 teach the same sense: stay calm, think clearly, check facts, delegate or request help in a tense situation. Their seven-step outcomes and crisis-response examples overlap materially; the main difference is the surface wording. Canonical 491's detector cannot match the Books 10–16 form, so coverage needs a decision, but a separate owner would duplicate an existing lesson.
findings.recommendedRepair: Hold 4194 from selection while deciding whether to expand canonical 491 to teach/detect 'keep your head' as a valid same-sense variant and attach source 2083, or otherwise document a demonstrably distinct learner decision. Do not treat surface-form mismatch alone as a new-sense justification.
